import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def task_func(file_path="data.csv", columns=["A", "B", "C"]):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    # Read CSV into a DataFrame
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    # Convert the requested columns to floats where possible
    plot_columns = [col for col in columns if col in df.columns]
    if not plot_columns:
        plot_columns = [col for col in df.columns if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col])]

    for col in plot_columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype(float)

    # Also ensure any already-numeric columns are stored as floats
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]) and df[col].dtype != float:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(float)

    # Create the plot
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    for col in plot_columns:
        if df[col].notna().any():
            ax.plot(df.index, df[col], label=col)

    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Line Chart")
    if plot_columns:
        ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Compute cube-root of the first available plotted column
    cube_source = next((col for col in plot_columns if df[col].notna().any()), None)
    if cube_source is None:
        cube_root_series = pd.Series(dtype=float, name="cube_root")
    else:
        cube_root_series = pd.Series(
            np.cbrt(df[cube_source].astype(float)),
            index=df.index,
            name=f"{cube_source}_cube_root",
        )

    return df, ax, cube_root_series
